answer_2.quote: We evaluated the performance in multiple triplet extraction with a standard metric Micro F1, precision (P.) and recall (R.). For single triplet extraction, we used accuracy (Acc.).

answer_4.quote: We invited two English-speaking graduate students to score 150 randomly selected utterances with triplets. Both the dataset of ... and our re-annotated triplets were scored in terms of 'consistency' (cns.) and 'specificity' (spec.) for relations and objects, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a score of 0 or 1 for each utterance-triplet pair on consistency and specificity.
